note: English translation of URAZUKE (Japanese is authoritative). Each entry keeps the Japanese source text, its sha256, and the commit of the source file at translation time.

df879e48b7a9ffb860709700181dc50bed83319e.ja:
## 表示と照会の規則（v0.3 追加, 2026-11-16）
- 意図を表す語（隠蔽・改ざん・操作・捏造など）を使わない。表示は「数値の不一致」「欠落」「説明のない改訂」に限る。
- 個人名や個人が特定できる記述を書かない。対象は「法務総合研究所」「矯正局」などの組織と、文書に限る。
- 照会の日付、照会の文面、回答の全文を記録して、公開する。
df879e48b7a9ffb860709700181dc50bed83319e.en:
## Rules on display and inquiry (added in v0.3, 2026-11-16)
- Words implying intent (such as "concealment", "falsification", "manipulation" or "fabrication") are not used. Labels are limited to "numerical mismatch", "gap" and "unexplained revision".
- Names of individuals and descriptions that could identify an individual are not written. The subjects are limited to organisations such as the "Research and Training Institute" and the "Correction Bureau", and to documents.
- The date of each inquiry, the text of the inquiry, and the full text of the response are recorded and published.

90a54367f59e63900921a562eb7718e76e21e114.ja:
# URAZUKE 検証の方法（v0.2, 2026-11-17）
理念：日本の犯罪・司法・精神医療・福祉に関する公開データを、再現可能な方法で検証し、継続的に記録する。
90a54367f59e63900921a562eb7718e76e21e114.en:
# URAZUKE Verification Methods (v0.2, 2026-11-17)
Principle: to verify public data on crime, justice, psychiatric care and welfare in Japan by reproducible methods, and to record the results continuously.

6fcddae4cf8c2dfbc41d9c8a5457b525f2911488.ja:
## 表示（サイト全体）
- 検証は LLM（Claude, GPT）がコードで行う。
- 記録の内容（何を発見とするか、区分、確実さ）は、人が判断しない。事前に固定した手順と、別系統の LLM による反証で決める。人は結果を書き換えない。
- 人（運営者）は、手順の設計と公開、誤りが見つかったときの訂正、照会と回答への対応、個人名など危害につながる情報の除外に責任を負う。
- 各記録に確認の状態を表示する。
6fcddae4cf8c2dfbc41d9c8a5457b525f2911488.en:
## Statement (site-wide)
- Verification is carried out in code by LLMs (Claude, GPT).
- The content of records (what counts as a finding, its category, its certainty) is not decided by people. It is decided by procedures fixed in advance and by refutation by an independent model. People do not rewrite the results.
- People (the operator) are responsible for designing and publishing the procedures, for correction when errors are found, for handling inquiries and responses, and for excluding information that could lead to harm, such as personal names.
- Each record shows its verification status.

f51fb3448122569909607b4d2c9ad65ef0997c14.ja:
## 人の判断を入れない理由
- 運営者は、検証の対象（加害者処遇の政策など）と利害を共有している（進め方 §2）。人が内容を判断すると、記録はその人の見解として読まれ、反論も人に向かう。手順だけで決めれば、反論は手順とコードに向けられ、誰でも同じ手順で確かめられる。
- 人の確認は、記録の数が増えると追いつかない。別系統の LLM による反証は、人の確認より多くの誤りを、より早く見つけている（訂正の記録を参照）。
- これは責任を手放すことではない。内容の判断を手順に預け、手順と公開の責任を人が負う。
f51fb3448122569909607b4d2c9ad65ef0997c14.en:
## Why human judgment is not included
- The operator shares interests with the subjects of verification (such as policy on the treatment of offenders) (Process §2). If a person judges the content, the records are read as that person's views, and objections are directed at the person. If decisions are made by the procedure alone, objections are directed at the procedure and the code, and anyone can check them with the same procedure.
- Human review cannot keep up as the number of records grows. Refutation by an independent model has found more errors, and faster, than human review (see Corrections).
- This is not giving up responsibility. Judgment of content is entrusted to the procedure, and people bear responsibility for the procedure and its publication.

8d328f35d39b614abf958fd6da11d78052e3aa97.ja:
## 確認の状態（各発見に必ず付ける）
| 状態 | 意味 |
|---|---|
| 機械検証のみ | スクリプトによる再現と陰性対照は済み。独立したLLMの確認は未実施 |
| 別系統で支持 | 別の会社の LLM が、結論を伏せた反証の手順で、同じ結論に達した |
| 別系統で不支持 | 反証で覆った。記録を撤回または修正し、訂正の記録に残す |
| 照会中／回答あり | 担当部署に照会した。回答があれば要旨と日付を記す |
8d328f35d39b614abf958fd6da11d78052e3aa97.en:
## Verification status (always attached to each finding)
| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| Machine-verified only | Reproduction by script and the negative control are complete. Confirmation by an independent LLM has not been carried out |
| Supported by an independent model | An LLM from a different company reached the same conclusion through a refutation procedure with the conclusion withheld |
| Not supported by an independent model | Overturned by refutation. The record is withdrawn or corrected and logged in Corrections |
| Inquiry pending / Response received | An inquiry was sent to the responsible department. If a response is received, its summary and date are recorded |

eb24a779a4cf791ed0b242b0377b923a9bedcb3a.ja:
## 検証の段階
L1 内部整合（合計・構成比・前年比） / L2 一次資料照合 / L3 版間差分 / L4 形式間差分（閲覧用と機械判読用、PDFとExcel） / L5 統計の再計算 / L6 公表表からの再分析（層別・逆算・標準化） / L7 設計の検討（群の作り方・欠けている変数・報告書間の定義変更） / L8 文脈（政策の時系列）
L1・L2 は全件を機械で回す。収穫は L3 以降に多い。
eb24a779a4cf791ed0b242b0377b923a9bedcb3a.en:
## Verification levels
L1 internal consistency (totals, composition ratios, year-on-year changes) / L2 cross-check against primary sources / L3 differences between editions / L4 differences between formats (for viewing vs machine-readable, PDF vs Excel) / L5 recalculation of statistics / L6 reanalysis from published tables (stratification, back-calculation, standardisation) / L7 examination of design (how groups were formed, missing variables, definition changes between reports) / L8 context (policy timeline)
L1 and L2 are run by machine on all items. Most findings come from L3 onwards.

5c1b57af1d05789a4d8868dc3db0100dbe8d20fe.ja:
## 影響の大きさ（トップの3列）
人の評価ではなく、次の規則で機械的に割り当てる。迷う場合は小さいほうに置く。
| 表示 | 規則 |
|---|---|
| 大：結論・指標に関わる | 報告書の結論・要約、政策の指標、全国の総数など、公表された主要な数字そのものが変わる、またはその読み方が変わる |
| 中：値が食い違う | 統計表の値が、版・資料・表の間で食い違う、または欠ける。利用者が違う値を使いうる |
| 小：形式の不備 | 機械判読用の Excel など副次的なファイルだけの不備で、本体（PDF・閲覧用）の値は正しい |
5c1b57af1d05789a4d8868dc3db0100dbe8d20fe.en:
## Size of impact (the three columns on the top page)
Assigned mechanically by the following rules, not by human assessment. When in doubt, the smaller category is used.
| Label | Rule |
|---|---|
| High: Affects conclusions or indicators | A main published figure itself (a report's conclusion or summary, a policy indicator, a national total, etc.) changes, or the way it is read changes |
| Medium: Values disagree | Values in statistical tables disagree between editions, sources or tables, or are missing. Users may use different values |
| Low: Format defect | A defect only in a secondary file such as a machine-readable Excel file; the values in the main publication (PDF, for viewing) are correct |

a023320f0ef63e31aaac68195bb769dccc47467a.ja:
## 発見の格付け
A 数値の誤り / B 説明のない改訂 / C 結論が頑健でない / D 設計上の問題 / E 書かれていない数値（公表値からの逆算）
a023320f0ef63e31aaac68195bb769dccc47467a.en:
## Grading of findings
A numerical error / B unexplained revision / C conclusion not robust / D design issue / E unstated figure (back-calculated from published values)

80724095276c286545f564ef101b33c7480bc86b.ja:
## 発見を確定する条件
1. 原文を引用する（ページ番号つき）。推測と原文を区別する。
2. ハッシュで固定した原データからスクリプトで再現できる。
3. 陰性対照（値を変えると検出されること）を確かめる。
4. 別の説明を先に探す：注記、正誤表、定義の変更、後の版での訂正。
5. 確実さを明記する：確定／推定／要照会。
6. 独立に確認する：別のLLMに、判定を見せずに検討させる。
7. 人は内容を判断しない。人が関わるのは、手順の変更（変更点と理由を記録し、変更後の記録にだけ適用する）と、危害を避けるための除外（個人名など）に限る。
80724095276c286545f564ef101b33c7480bc86b.en:
## Conditions for establishing a finding
1. Quote the original text (with page numbers). Distinguish inference from the original text.
2. The finding can be reproduced by script from source data fixed by hash.
3. Confirm the negative control (that the issue is detected when a value is changed).
4. Look for other explanations first: notes, errata, changes in definition, corrections in later editions.
5. State the certainty explicitly: Established / Inferred / Requires inquiry.
6. Confirm independently: have a different LLM examine it without showing it the judgment.
7. People do not judge content. Human involvement is limited to changes to the procedure (the change and its reason are recorded and applied only to records made after the change) and exclusions to avoid harm (personal names, etc.).

ed87dc46a10509fa30fa69c03b4fe69c84a698f4.ja:
## 一つの対象に対する作業の順序
取得とハッシュによる固定 → L1〜L5 を機械で一巡 → 版間差分 → 結論の一文を特定し、それを支える表を再分析 → 設計を読む（前の報告からの定義変更の一覧を含む） → 発見カード → 照会 → 期限を決めて公開
ed87dc46a10509fa30fa69c03b4fe69c84a698f4.en:
## Order of work for one subject
Acquisition and fixing by hash → one machine pass through L1–L5 → differences between editions → identify the one-sentence conclusion and reanalyse the tables that support it → read the design (including a list of definition changes from the previous report) → finding card → inquiry → publication by a set deadline

384418f97c015fedc64430e78706d1484deab448.ja:
## 発見カードの項目
ID / 対象（版・表・ページ） / 原文の引用 / 確かめ方（スクリプトとコミット） / 結果 / 格付け / 確実さ / 確認の状態 / 照会と回答
384418f97c015fedc64430e78706d1484deab448.en:
## Fields of a finding card
ID / Subject (edition, table, page) / Quotation of original text / How to reproduce (script and commit) / Result / Grade / Certainty / Verification status / Inquiry and response

b8e00e257fb22ba27a0de6977349c57359e71cf9.ja:
## 対象の優先順位
重点領域（2026-11-17〜）：司法・犯罪、医療（精神医療・司法精神医療）、児童虐待・子ども、障害福祉、司法と接する福祉（出所者の福祉へのつなぎ、生活保護など）。重点領域の外の統計は、新しく取り上げない。既存の記録と照合の結果（陰性の結果を含む）は残す。
1. 因果を主張する効果検証の報告書（性犯罪、薬物、就労、保護観察）
2. 見出しになる数字（再犯率、認知件数）
3. 機械判読用データ（再利用が多い）
b8e00e257fb22ba27a0de6977349c57359e71cf9.en:
## Priority of subjects
Focus areas (from 2026-11-17): justice and crime; medicine (psychiatric care and forensic psychiatric care); child abuse and children; disability welfare; welfare at the interface with justice (linking released persons to welfare, public assistance, etc.). Statistics outside the focus areas are not newly taken up. Existing records and cross-check results (including negative results) are kept.
1. Evaluation reports that claim causal effects (sexual offences, drugs, employment, probation)
2. Headline figures (recidivism rates, numbers of offences known to the police)
3. Machine-readable data (widely reused)

a0b89592264563f63789cf68f0d7c8b670e78219.ja:
## 手順の変更の記録
変更点と理由を記し、変更後の記録にだけ適用する（記録をさかのぼって書き換える場合は、その旨も記す）。
- 2026-11-17　影響の大きさ（大・中・小）の規則を新たに作った。作ったのは25件の記録を見た後である。最初の振り分けのあと、「小」の規則を「機械判読用の Excel など副次的なファイルだけの不備で、本体の値は正しい」と明確にし、HK-A2・HK-A5 を中から小に移した。
- 2026-11-17　事前登録の範囲を「再分析・設計上の問題・効果についての主張と、運営者の業務に関わる対象」に明確にした。機械的な照合で見つかった食い違いは、検査の固定と陰性対照で代える。
- 2026-11-17　作成者の意図についての仮説を、記録の対象から外した。該当する事前登録（H001）と再現の記録（R001・R002）は公開を控え、sha256 で固定した（publish/WITHHELD.tsv）。
- 2026-11-17　別系統の反証で、教科書的な統計手法の知識の使用を認めた（H007・R007 から）。資料の事実は資料だけで確かめる条件は変えない。
- 2026-11-17　原文の引用（頁・シート番号つき）を checks/quotes/locate.py で機械的に抽出し、全記録に付けた。
- 2026-11-17　対象の範囲を「日本の犯罪・司法・精神医療に関する公開データ」から「日本の公的統計と公開資料」に広げた（運営者の決定）。既存の記録はそのまま残す。対象の優先順位は下の「対象の優先順位」による。
- 2026-11-17（r08）　原文の引用の機械抽出（checks/quotes/locate.py）が e-Stat の CSV（Shift_JIS）を読めるようにした。位置は「CSV n行」で示す。
- 2026-11-17（r08）　違いの説明が同じ公表物の別の箇所（概況 PDF の注、隣の表の注など）にある場合は記録にせず、作業ノートに「説明のある違い」として書く（例：人口動態統計 第4表の都道府県の和と全国の差は第5表の注で、毎月勤労統計 2024年の指数と前年比の差は概況の注6で説明されている）。表そのものに注がないことは作業ノートに書く。
- 2026-11-17（r08）　白書は「白書の数値と、引用元の統計の値」を突き合わせる（L4 と同じ型）。決算検査報告は指摘の当否を扱わず、報告に載った件数・金額を統計表と同じ手順で検査する。
- 2026-11-17（r08）　Web ページの本文を道具で抜き出すと、HTML のコメントの中の（表示されない）文やリンクも拾うことがある。ページの記述を根拠にする前に、表示される部分かどうかを確かめる（労働力調査の結果ページで、コメント内の2019年の要約と2022年の表へのリンクを拾った）。
- 2026-11-17（r08）　Excel の数値が文字列で入っているセルは、和の照合で黙って飛ばされることがある。文字列の数字を数える検査（c1103）を置き、照合の件数に入らなかったセルを確かめる。
- 2026-11-17（r09）　公表元の「正誤情報」が出ている統計では、各訂正が現行の配布ファイルに反映されているかを確かめる（lib/seigo.py：表側の行と表頭の列が一つに定まったセルだけで判定し、行の中に値があるかだけの判定は使わない。同じ箇所を後の正誤表が訂正し直した場合は最後のもので判定する。正誤表はシートごとに年が違うことがある）。
- 2026-11-17（r09）　表の見出しは結合セルを広げてから列ごとに連結する（親の見出しが子の列に付かないと、同じ名前の列を取り違える）。
- 2026-11-17（r09）　陰性対照で Excel を書き換えるときは、式の入ったセルの計算済みの値が消えないよう、値として読み込んでから保存する（openpyxl の data_only）。PDF を読む検査の陰性対照は、pdftotext の出力の1か所を置き換える包み（checks/generic/bin/pdftotext_negctl.sh）で行う。xls は xlutils で書き換える。
- 2026-11-17（r09）　総数のセルが二つの独立した式（内訳の和、流れの式）の両方と合わず、ほかのセルどうしは合う場合は、「どのセルが違うかは推定」として記録する。どちらの値が正しいかは、原資料か公表元の回答がない限り決めない（区分は不整合）。
a0b89592264563f63789cf68f0d7c8b670e78219.en:
## Record of procedure changes
The change and its reason are recorded, and the change is applied only to records made after it (where records are rewritten retroactively, this is also stated).
- 2026-11-17 Created new rules for size of impact (High, Medium, Low). They were created after viewing 25 records. After the initial assignment, the 'Low' rule was clarified as 'a defect only in a secondary file such as a machine-readable Excel file, with the values in the main publication correct', and HK-A2 and HK-A5 were moved from Medium to Low.
- 2026-11-17 Clarified the scope of preregistration as 'reanalyses, design issues, claims about effects, and subjects related to the operator's work'. For discrepancies found by mechanical cross-checks, fixing the checks and negative controls take its place.
- 2026-11-17 Removed hypotheses about the author's intent from the scope of records. The corresponding preregistration (H001) and reproduction records (R001, R002) are withheld from publication and fixed by sha256 (publish/WITHHELD.tsv).
- 2026-11-17 Allowed the use of textbook knowledge of statistical methods in refutation by the independent model (from H007 and R007). The condition that facts about sources are checked only against the sources themselves is unchanged.
- 2026-11-17 Quotations of the original text (with page and sheet numbers) were extracted mechanically with checks/quotes/locate.py and attached to all records.
- 2026-11-17 Broadened the scope of subjects from 'public data on crime, justice and psychiatric care in Japan' to 'Japanese official statistics and public documents' (operator's decision). Existing records are kept as they are. The priority of subjects follows 'Priority of subjects' below.
- 2026-11-17 (r08) Enabled the mechanical extraction of quotations (checks/quotes/locate.py) to read e-Stat CSV files (Shift_JIS). Locations are given as 'CSV row n'.
- 2026-11-17 (r08) Where the explanation for a difference is found elsewhere in the same publication (a note in the overview PDF, a note to an adjacent table, etc.), it is not made a record but is written in the working notes as an 'explained difference' (e.g. the difference between the sum of prefectures and the national figure in Vital Statistics Table 4 is explained in a note to Table 5, and the difference between the 2024 index and the year-on-year change in the Monthly Labour Survey is explained in note 6 of the overview). The absence of a note on the table itself is written in the working notes.
- 2026-11-17 (r08) For white papers, 'the figures in the white paper and the values in the cited statistics' are compared (the same type as L4). For the Audit Report (Board of Audit), the validity of the findings is not addressed; the counts and amounts in the report are checked by the same procedure as statistical tables.
- 2026-11-17 (r08) When the body text of a web page is extracted with a tool, it may pick up text and links inside HTML comments (which are not displayed). Before relying on a page's content, confirm whether it is in the displayed part (on the Labour Force Survey results page, a 2019 summary and a link to a 2022 table inside a comment were picked up).
- 2026-11-17 (r08) Excel cells in which numbers are stored as text may be silently skipped in sum checks. A check that counts numbers stored as text (c1103) was added, to confirm the cells that were not included in the count of cross-checked cells.
- 2026-11-17 (r09) For statistics where the publisher has issued 'errata information', check whether each correction is reflected in the currently distributed file (lib/seigo.py: judgment is made only on cells uniquely identified by a row in the stub and a column in the heading; judgment based only on whether a value exists in the row is not used. Where a later errata re-corrects the same location, the last one is used. Errata may refer to different years for different sheets).
- 2026-11-17 (r09) Table headings are concatenated column by column after expanding merged cells (if a parent heading is not attached to its child columns, columns with the same name are confused).
- 2026-11-17 (r09) When rewriting Excel files for negative controls, the data are read as values before saving so that the computed values of cells containing formulas are not lost (openpyxl data_only). Negative controls for checks that read PDFs use a wrapper that replaces one location in the pdftotext output (checks/generic/bin/pdftotext_negctl.sh). xls files are rewritten with xlutils.
- 2026-11-17 (r09) Where a total cell matches neither of two independent formulas (the sum of the breakdown, the flow formula) while the other cells match each other, it is recorded as 'which cell differs is inferred'. Which value is correct is not decided unless there is a primary source or a response from the publisher (category: inconsistency).

- 2026-11-17（r10）　対象の範囲を重点領域（司法・犯罪、精神医療・司法精神医療、児童虐待・子ども、障害福祉、司法と接する福祉）に絞り、広く浅い照合から、結論を主張する資料の深掘りに重心を移した（運営者の決定）。理由：r09 で13統計を加えた結果、「中」以上の記録は結論を主張する資料の読み込みから出ており、広い恒等式の照合からはほとんど出なかったため。児童虐待・障害福祉を含めたのは、運営者の業務（加害者の治療）に直接は関わらない領域を重点に入れ、対象が業務の側に偏らないようにするため。重点領域の多くは運営者の業務に関わる対象になるので、事前登録と別系統の反証を標準とする。r09 までの重点領域外の13統計の結果（陰性の結果を含む）は残す。

## 2026-11-16 に得た教訓（LLM による検証の誤りから）
- c009：同名の見出しが衝突して、偽の変化が出た → 見出しは上位の階層と連番で区別する。
- c008：同じセル位置での照合は、偶然の一致ばかりを拾った → 照合では値の一致だけでなく、表題と行・列の意味の一致まで確かめる。
- 対照群を「刑期不足」と推測したが、原文の脚注で否定された → 推測を書く前に原文全体を検索する。
e041f91dc80a2ee5c46abc5d1679f91fb39fb645.en:
## Lessons learned on 2026-11-16 (from errors in verification by LLMs)
- c009: headings with the same name collided and produced false changes → headings are distinguished by their parent levels and serial numbers.
- c008: cross-checks at the same cell position picked up only coincidental matches → cross-checks confirm not only that values match but also that the table title and the meanings of rows and columns match.
- The control group was inferred to be 'insufficient sentence length', but this was contradicted by a footnote in the original text → search the entire original text before writing an inference.

## 仮説と反証の条件（v0.2 追加, 2026-11-16）
- 再分析・設計上の問題・効果についての主張と、運営者の業務に関わる対象の記録には、計算や反証の前に、仮説・外れうる予測・判断の基準を hypotheses/Hxxx.md に書き、コミットしてから検定する（事後に解釈を合わせないため）。
- 合計・版・資料の機械的な照合で見つかった食い違いは、検査そのもの（スクリプト）を先に固定したものとみなし、個別の事前登録は要しない。検査の働きは陰性対照で確かめる。
- 厳しさ：予測が算術的・構造的に必ず当たるものは検定とみなさない（例：全体が無効で部分集団Aが有効なら、補集合は必ず不利に出る）。外れる余地が現実にある予測を選ぶ。
- 対称性：記録の側の批判にも反証の条件を置く（例：「罪名構成で効果が消える」は、個票でRATと罪名を同時に調整してもHRが有意に1未満なら棄却）。
- 作成者の意図についての仮説は、記録の対象にしない。

## Hypotheses and refutation conditions (added in v0.2, 2026-11-16)
- For records of reanalyses, design issues, claims about effects, and subjects related to the operator's work, the hypothesis, predictions that could fail, and decision criteria are written in hypotheses/Hxxx.md and committed before calculation or refutation, and only then tested (so that interpretations are not fitted after the fact).
- Discrepancies found by mechanical cross-checks of totals, editions and sources are treated as having the check itself (the script) fixed in advance, and do not require individual preregistration. The functioning of the check is confirmed by negative controls.
- Severity: predictions that are bound to hold arithmetically or structurally are not treated as tests (e.g. if the whole is ineffective and subgroup A is effective, the complement will necessarily appear unfavourable). Predictions with a real chance of failing are chosen.
- Symmetry: refutation conditions are also set for criticisms made on the record side (e.g. 'the effect disappears with offence composition' is rejected if the HR is significantly below 1 even when RAT and offence type are adjusted for simultaneously using individual-level data).
- Hypotheses about the author's intent are not made subjects of records.

- 2026-11-17 (r26) Each cross-check now writes its own summary (lib/tally.py) (the transitional transcription source=adapter was discontinued). Classification: if values differ between sources, it is a "discrepancy" (including revisions between editions and differences between provisional and final values; those that can be explained by a note, errata, an announcement, or a difference in definition stated in the source are "explained"). Cases arising from how the check reads the data (confusion with a different table, page numbers mixed in, misreading a percentage column as a count column or vice versa, reading rows that are not a breakdown as a breakdown, tables or columns that cannot be matched, flags confirmed in the working notes as false detections, flags not confirmed against the original text) are "reading failures" and are not included in the number of cross-checks. Places confirmed in the working notes as errors in the source are written within the check by table number or similar and counted as discrepancies. The following 7 were added to Auxiliary (not included in the number of cross-checks): c008 (same cell position in the previous year's edition; many coincidental matches, so it cannot be used for judgment), c009 and c009g (comparison between editions matching tables by file name; renumbering of figures and tables causes tables to be mismatched; replaced by c009h), c011 and c012 (old versions of the cross-check between for-viewing and machine-readable files; replaced by c012g; c012 performs the same processing as c012g for the 2023 edition (Reiwa 5)), c505 (a candidate search that looks for numeric strings from errata information in the white paper; not a cross-check of values), c703 (only places two counts with different definitions side by side; no match is expected). To avoid counting the same value twice, for checks that take arguments only rows with yes in the tally column of checks/RUN.tsv are counted (editions where retrieval stopped partway, positive controls, and pairs that cannot be used with the old format are no). For c009h and c009v, the order is now fixed when counterpart candidates are tied (previously the counterpart could change each time the check was run).

- 2026-11-17 (r24) The main feature of the top page was changed from columns by size of impact to a band of record stages (Cross-check → Record (Before inquiry) → Inquiry pending → Response received / deadline passed → Resolved). The cross-check stage shows the number of cross-checks (for the statistics counted automatically), and the stages to its right show the number of records; the units are stated separately. The Resolved stage holds corrections by the publishing agency and corrections and withdrawals of records by URAZUKE (the number of entries in Corrections). Size of impact is kept in the record tags and in the list filters. Child Abuse Consultations Handled (c701) and Disciplinary Actions against School Staff (c601) were added to the statistics whose cross-checks are counted automatically. Checks whose discrepancy counts include reading failures (White Paper on Recidivism Prevention c501, stalking c411 and c412) are not included in the cross-check count.
- 2026-11-17 (r25) It was decided to unify the counting of cross-checks into a summary common to all checks (lib/tally.py: number cross-checked, discrepancies, reading failures, explained discrepancies). The check register (checks/TALLY.tsv, checks/generic/build_tally_registry.py) lists all checks, divided into "Cross-check" and "Auxiliary", and records whether a summary exists (tallied / not tallied). The top-page "What was confirmed" section no longer shows only the statistics that could be counted, as cards; it shows all statistics in the same table (those not tallied are marked as not tallied). Reason: showing only the statistics whose numbers could be counted can be read as presenting a selection (pointed out by the operator). Reading failures are not included in the cross-check count. During the transition, summaries transcribed from existing outputs are marked source=adapter.
- 2026-11-17 (r26) Each cross-check now writes its own summary (lib/tally.py) (the transitional transcription source=adapter is discontinued). Classification: if values differ between sources, it is a "discrepancy" (including revisions between editions and differences between provisional and final values; those that can be explained by notes, errata, notices, or differences in definitions stated in the source are "explained"). Those arising from how the check reads the data (confusion with another table, page numbers mixed in, misreading of percentage and count columns, reading rows that are not a breakdown as a breakdown, tables or columns that cannot be matched, flags confirmed in the working notes as false detections, flags not confirmed against the original) are "reading failures" and are not included in the cross-check count. Points confirmed in the working notes as errors in the source are written in the check by table number etc. and counted as discrepancies. The following seven were added to Auxiliary (not included in the cross-check count): c008 (same cell position in the previous edition; there are many coincidental matches, so it cannot be used for judgment), c009 and c009g (comparison between editions that matches tables by file name; tables are mismatched when figure and table numbers are renumbered; replaced by c009h), c011 and c012 (older versions of the cross-check between for-viewing and machine-readable files; replaced by c012g; c012 performs the same processing as c012g for the 2023 edition (Reiwa 5)), c505 (a candidate search that looks for the numeric strings of errata information in the white paper; not a cross-check of values), c703 (only places two numbers with different definitions side by side; no match is expected). To avoid counting the same values twice, for checks that take arguments, only rows with yes in the tally column of checks/RUN.tsv are counted (editions where retrieval stopped midway, positive controls, and pairs that cannot be used with the old format are no). For c009h and c009v, an order was set for when counterpart candidates are tied (previously the counterpart could change from run to run).
- 2026-11-17 (r26 continued) The top-page "What was confirmed" table and each statistic's page show "of which explained" (operator's decision). "Explained" means that the reason for the difference is written in the source (notes, errata, correction notices, an explicit statement that values are provisional or preliminary, etc.); it is not a judgment of whether the difference is correct. Reason: if explainable and unexplained differences are mixed into a single number, the size of the number is read as the size of the problem. The cross-check table on each statistic's page (check, what was cross-checked, number cross-checked, discrepancies, of which explained, reading failures) is built from the check's summary (the note and counts in lib/tally.py). Hand-written descriptions (VDESC in build_site.py and the CHK sentences containing numbers) were discontinued. The discrepancies in c402 (addition of categories in the 2021 edition (Reiwa 3)) and c601 (replacement with a notice in the FY2021 edition (Reiwa 3)) were changed to explained.

- 2026-11-17 (r24)　The main element of the top page was changed from columns by size of impact to a band of record stages (Comparison → Record (Before inquiry) → Inquiry pending → Response received / Deadline passed → Resolved). The Comparison stage shows the number of comparisons (for statistics that are counted automatically), and the stages to its right show the number of records; the units are written separately. The Resolved stage holds corrections by the publishing body and corrections and withdrawals of records by URAZUKE (the number of entries in Corrections). The size of impact is kept on the record labels and in the list filters. Child Abuse Consultations Handled (c701) and Disciplinary Actions against School Staff (c601) were added to the statistics whose number of comparisons is counted automatically. Checks in which the number of discrepancies includes reading failures (White Paper on Recidivism Prevention c501, stalking c411 and c412) are not included in the number of comparisons.
- 2026-11-17 (r25)　It was decided to unify the way the number of comparisons is counted into a summary common to all checks (lib/tally.py: number compared, discrepancies, reading failures, explained discrepancies). In the check register (checks/TALLY.tsv, checks/generic/build_tally_registry.py), all checks are listed, divided into "Comparison" and "Auxiliary", and whether a summary exists (tallied / not tallied) is recorded. "What was confirmed" on the top page no longer shows only the statistics that could be counted as cards; all statistics are shown in the same table (those not tallied are marked as not tallied). Reason: showing only the statistics whose numbers could be counted could be read as showing a selection (pointed out by the operator). Reading failures are not included in the number of comparisons. During the transition, summaries written from existing output are marked source=adapter.
- 2026-11-17 (r26)　Each comparison check now writes its own summary (lib/tally.py) (the transitional transcription source=adapter is discontinued). Classification: if values differ between sources, it is a "discrepancy" (including revisions between editions and differences between provisional and final values; those that can be explained by a note, errata, a notice, or a difference in definition stated in the source are "explained"). Cases arising from how the check reads the data (confusion with another table, page numbers mixed in, misreading percentage and count columns, reading rows that are not a breakdown as a breakdown, tables or columns that cannot be matched, flags confirmed as false detections in the working notes, flags not confirmed against the original) are "reading failures" and are not included in the number of comparisons. Places confirmed in the working notes as errors in the source are written in the check by table number etc. and counted as discrepancies. The following seven were added to Auxiliary (not included in the number of comparisons): c008 (the same cell position in the previous year's edition; many coincidental matches, so it cannot be used for judgment), c009 and c009g (comparison between editions that matches tables by file name; tables are mismatched when figure and table numbers are reassigned; replaced by c009h), c011 and c012 (old versions of the comparison between the for-viewing and machine-readable versions; replaced by c012g; c012 performs the same processing as the 2023 edition (Reiwa 5) in c012g), c505 (a search for candidates that looks for numeric strings from errata information in the white paper; not a comparison of values), c703 (only places two numbers with different definitions side by side and does not expect them to match). To avoid counting the same value twice, for checks that take arguments only rows with yes in the tally column of checks/RUN.tsv are counted (editions where retrieval stopped partway, positive controls, and pairs that cannot be used with the old format are no). For c009h and c009v, the order was fixed for when candidate counterparts are tied (previously the counterpart could change on each run).
- 2026-11-17 (r26 continued)　"Of which explained" is shown in the table under "What was confirmed" on the top page and on each statistic's page (decision by the operator). "Explained" means the reason for the difference is written in the source (a note, errata, a correction notice, an explicit statement that values are provisional or preliminary, etc.); it is not a judgment of whether the difference is correct. Reason: if explainable and unexplained differences are mixed into a single number, the size of the number is read as the size of the problem. The comparison table on each statistic's page (check, what was compared, number compared, discrepancies, of which explained, reading failures) is built from the check summaries (the note and numbers in lib/tally.py). Hand-written descriptions (VDESC in build_site.py and CHK text containing numbers) were discontinued. The discrepancies in c402 (addition of a category in the 2021 edition (Reiwa 3)) and c601 (replacement with a notice in the FY2021 edition (Reiwa 3)) were changed to explained. For revisions between editions of the White Paper on Crime (c009h, c009v, c004), the notes and column headings of the old and new editions were checked table by table, and only those whose reason is written in the white paper were classified as explained (rules in lib/hanzai_explained.py; those whose reason is not written in the white paper, such as revisions of population rates due to corrections in the population estimates, remain unexplained).
- 2026-11-17 (r26 continued)　The order of statistics was decided (decision by the operator). The table under "What was confirmed" on the top page, the list of statistics, and the top-page sections (Japanese and English) are all ordered by field → publishing body → Japanese syllabary order of the statistic name. The publishing body is the first-named organisation, ordered according to the National Government Organization Act and the Act for Establishment of the Cabinet Office (the Cabinet Office and its external agencies first), followed by the National Personnel Authority, the Board of Audit, the courts and research institutions. Statistics are not ordered by number compared or number of discrepancies (because putting statistics with large numbers first would be read as an order of the size of the problem). The previous order was the order in which verification was started.

## 確認の状態（各発見に必ず付ける）
| 状態 | 意味 |
|---|---|
| 反証にかける前（記録の表記は「機械検証のみ」） | スクリプトによる再現と陰性対照は済み。独立したLLMの反証はまだ |
| 書き直して再反証待ち | 反証で「判定不能」または「反証」となり、文を書き直した。書き直した文はまだ反証にかけていない |
| 別系統で支持 | 別の会社の LLM が、結論を伏せた反証の手順で、同じ結論に達した |
| 別系統では判定不能（確定） | 2回続けて判定不能となり、確かめられる部分に狭めても判定不能だった。理由を記録に書く（PROCESS §3） |
| 別系統で不支持 | 反証で覆った。記録を撤回または修正し、訂正の記録に残す |
| 照会中／回答あり | 担当部署に照会した。回答があれば要旨と日付を記す |
ab9dc7b4ef9dc9dfefe22d31bf597090d88ced36.en:
## Verification status (always attached to each finding)
| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| Before refutation (shown in the record as "Machine-verified only") | Reproduction by script and the negative control are complete. Refutation by an independent LLM has not yet been done |
| Rewritten, awaiting re-refutation | The refutation returned "Inconclusive" or "Refutation", and the statement was rewritten. The rewritten statement has not yet been submitted to refutation |
| Supported by an independent model | An LLM from a different company reached the same conclusion through the refutation procedure, with the conclusion withheld |
| Inconclusive by an independent model (Established) | The result was inconclusive twice in a row, and remained inconclusive even after the statement was narrowed to the parts that can be checked. The reason is written in the record (PROCESS §3) |
| Not supported by an independent model | The finding was overturned by the refutation. The record is withdrawn or corrected, and this is entered in Corrections |
| Inquiry pending / Response received | An inquiry was made to the responsible department. If a response is received, its summary and date are recorded |

## 人の判断を入れない理由
- 運営者は、検証の対象（加害者処遇の政策など）と利害を共有している（進め方 §2）。人が内容を判断すると、記録はその人の見解として読まれ、反論も人に向かう。手順だけで決めれば、反論は手順とコードに向けられ、誰でも同じ手順で確かめられる。
- 人の確認は、記録の数が増えると追いつかない。別系統の LLM による反証で見つかった誤りと、その直し方は、訂正の記録と方法の「反証の成績」の表に載せる。
- 人が決めていること：対象の選択、手順、表示の設計は運営者が決める（手順の変更の記録に「運営者の決定」と書く）。個々の記録の文と判定は、人が書き換えない。
- これは責任を手放すことではない。内容の判断を手順に預け、手順と公開の責任を人が負う。
002544773fc668d6e7f88c3f07efd9401a9f76b4.en:
## Why human judgment is not included
- The operator shares interests with the subjects of verification (such as policies on the treatment of offenders) (Process §2). If a person judges the content, the records are read as that person's views, and objections are directed at that person. If decisions are made by the procedure alone, objections are directed at the procedure and the code, and anyone can check the results by following the same procedure.
- Human review cannot keep up as the number of records grows. Errors found through refutation by an independent model (an LLM from a different company), and how they were corrected, are listed in Corrections and in the "refutation scoreboard" table in Methods.
- What humans decide: the operator decides the selection of subjects, the procedure and the design of the display (recorded as "operator's decision" in the record of procedure changes). Humans do not rewrite the text or verdict of individual records.
- This is not giving up responsibility. Judgment of content is entrusted to the procedure, and humans bear responsibility for the procedure and for publication.

eac1e727d8c80f9754ba2faccc354d96e02b501a.ja:
## 確認の状態（各発見に必ず付ける）
| 状態 | 意味 |
|---|---|
| 反証にかける前（記録の表記は「機械検証のみ」） | スクリプトによる再現と陰性対照は済み。独立したLLMの反証はまだ |
| 書き直して再反証待ち | 反証で「判定不能」または「反証」となり、文を書き直した。書き直した文はまだ反証にかけていない |
| 別系統で支持 | 主張の文を、正しいか誤りかを伏せ、偽の主張（対照）と混ぜて別の会社の LLM（現在は OpenAI の GPT）に渡し、資料だけで真偽を判定させた。対照をすべて正しく反証した回で、その主張が「支持」と判定された |
| 別系統では判定不能（確定） | 2回続けて判定不能となり、確かめられる部分に狭めても判定不能だった。理由を記録に書く（PROCESS §3） |
| 別系統で不支持 | 反証で覆った。記録を撤回または修正し、訂正の記録に残す |
| 照会中／回答あり | 担当部署に照会した。回答があれば要旨と日付を記す |
確認の状態は、PROCESS §3 の4つ（反証にかける前／書き直して再反証待ち／別系統で支持／別系統では判定不能（確定））。「別系統で不支持」は撤回または修正で終わるため状態としては残らず、「照会中／回答あり」は照会の状態として別の欄に出す。
eac1e727d8c80f9754ba2faccc354d96e02b501a.en:
## Verification status (always attached to each finding)
| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| Not yet put to a refutation check (shown on records as "Machine-verified only") | Reproduction by script and the negative control are done. Refutation by an independent LLM has not yet been done |
| Rewritten, awaiting a new refutation check | The refutation check returned "Inconclusive" or "Refutation", and the text was rewritten. The rewritten text has not yet been put to a refutation check |
| Supported by an independent model | The text of the claim, with whether it is true or false withheld, was mixed with false claims (controls) and given to an LLM from a different company (currently OpenAI's GPT), which was asked to judge truth or falsity from the source materials alone. In a round in which all controls were correctly refuted, the claim was judged "supported" |
| Undetermined by an independent model (final) | The result was Inconclusive twice in a row, and remained Inconclusive even after narrowing the claim to the part that can be checked. The reason is written in the record (PROCESS §3) |
| Not supported by an independent model | The claim was overturned by refutation. The record is withdrawn or corrected and logged in Corrections |
| Inquiry pending / Response received | An inquiry was sent to the responsible office. If there is a response, its summary and date are noted |
The verification statuses are the four in PROCESS §3 (Not yet put to a refutation check / Rewritten, awaiting a new refutation check / Supported by an independent model / Undetermined by an independent model (final)). "Not supported by an independent model" ends in withdrawal or correction and so does not remain as a status, and "Inquiry pending / Response received" is shown in a separate column as the inquiry status.

7f8cc6db1f81aac45c350cf00b87f78f24515c2a.ja:
## 影響の大きさ
人の評価ではなく、次の規則で機械的に割り当てる。迷う場合は小さいほうに置く。
| 表示 | 規則 |
|---|---|
| 大：結論・指標に関わる | 報告書の結論・要約、政策の指標、全国の総数など、公表された主要な数字そのものが変わる、またはその読み方が変わる |
| 中：値が食い違う | 統計表の値が、版・資料・表の間で食い違う、または欠ける。利用者が違う値を使いうる |
| 小：形式の不備 | 機械判読用の Excel など副次的なファイルだけの不備で、本体（PDF・閲覧用）の値は正しい |
7f8cc6db1f81aac45c350cf00b87f78f24515c2a.en:
## Size of impact
Assigned mechanically by the following rules, not by human evaluation. In case of doubt, the smaller one is assigned.
| Label | Rule |
|---|---|
| High: Affects conclusions or indicators | A main published figure itself, such as a report's conclusion or summary, a policy indicator or a national total, changes, or the way it is read changes |
| Medium: Values disagree | Values in statistical tables disagree between editions, sources or tables, or are missing. Users may use different values |
| Low: Format defect | A defect only in a secondary file, such as a machine-readable Excel file; the values in the main body (PDF, for viewing) are correct |

00f4f7016df216367df5d2e1d9606c9706326571.ja:
## 発見を確定する条件
1. 原文を引用する（ページ番号つき）。推測と原文を区別する。
2. ハッシュで固定した原データからスクリプトで再現できる。
3. 陰性対照（値を変えると検出されること）を確かめる。
4. 別の説明を先に探す：注記、正誤表、定義の変更、後の版での訂正。
5. 確実さを明記する：確定／推定／要照会。
6. 独立に確認する：別のLLMに、判定を見せずに検討させる。
7. 個々の記録の文と判定は、人が書き換えない。人が関わるのは、対象の選択、手順と表示の設計の変更（変更点と理由を記録し、変更後の記録にだけ適用する）と、危害を避けるための除外（個人名など）に限る。
00f4f7016df216367df5d2e1d9606c9706326571.en:
## Conditions for establishing a finding
1. Quote the original text (with page numbers). Distinguish inference from the original text.
2. It can be reproduced by script from original data fixed by hash.
3. Confirm the negative control (that a change in values is detected).
4. Look for other explanations first: notes, errata, changes in definitions, corrections in later editions.
5. State the certainty: Established / Inferred / Requires inquiry.
6. Confirm independently: have a different LLM examine it without showing it the verdict.
7. Humans do not rewrite the text or verdict of individual records. Human involvement is limited to the selection of subjects, changes to the design of the procedure and the display (the change and the reason are recorded, and it is applied only to records after the change), and exclusions to avoid harm (such as personal names).

## 確認の状態（各発見に必ず付ける）
| 状態 | 意味 |
|---|---|
| 反証にかける前（記録の表記は「機械検証のみ」） | スクリプトによる再現と陰性対照は済み。独立したLLMの反証はまだ |
| 書き直して再反証待ち | 反証で「判定不能」または「反証」となり、文を書き直した。書き直した文はまだ反証にかけていない |
| 別系統で支持 | 主張の文を、正しいか誤りかを伏せ、偽の主張（対照）と混ぜて別の会社の LLM（現在は OpenAI の GPT）に渡し、資料だけで真偽を判定させた。対照をすべて正しく反証した回で、その主張が「支持」と判定された |
| 別系統では判定不能（確定） | 2回続けて判定不能となり、確かめられる部分に狭めても判定不能だった。理由を記録に書く（進め方 §3） |
| 別系統で不支持 | 反証で覆った。記録を撤回または修正し、訂正の記録に残す |
| 照会中／回答あり | 担当部署に照会した。回答があれば要旨と日付を記す |
確認の状態は、進め方 §3 の4つ（反証にかける前／書き直して再反証待ち／別系統で支持／別系統では判定不能（確定））。「別系統で不支持」は撤回または修正で終わるため状態としては残らず、「照会中／回答あり」は照会の状態として別の欄に出す。
30681fcf7346130c0d937a1ab33a8b56fe5e0e90.en:
## Verification status (always attached to each finding)
| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| Not yet put to a refutation check (shown in the record as "Machine-verified only") | Reproduction by script and the negative control are done. Refutation by an independent LLM has not yet been done |
| Rewritten, awaiting a new refutation check | The refutation check returned "Inconclusive" or "Refutation", and the statement was rewritten. The rewritten statement has not yet been put to a refutation check |
| Supported by an independent model | The statement of the claim, without indicating whether it is correct or incorrect and mixed with false claims (controls), was given to an LLM from a different company (currently OpenAI's GPT), which was asked to judge true or false from the source materials alone. In a run in which all controls were correctly refuted, the claim was judged "supported" |
| Undetermined by an independent model (final) | The result was inconclusive twice in a row, and remained inconclusive even after narrowing the claim to the part that can be checked. The reason is written in the record (Process §3) |
| Not supported by an independent model | Overturned by the refutation check. The record is withdrawn or corrected, and this is recorded in Corrections |
| Inquiry pending / Response received | An inquiry was made to the responsible department. If a response is received, its summary and date are recorded |
The verification statuses are the four in Process §3 (Not yet put to a refutation check / Rewritten, awaiting a new refutation check / Supported by an independent model / Undetermined by an independent model (final)). "Not supported by an independent model" ends in withdrawal or correction and therefore does not remain as a status, and "Inquiry pending / Response received" is shown in a separate column as the inquiry status.
